name: Course
description: Turn reviewed course materials into proposed dates and tasks.

directory_requirements.label: Course materials folder
directory_requirements.access_disclosure: Ori reads the contents of supported files directly inside this folder after you consent. It does not read subfolders, and it does not copy the source files into the workspace.

steps.title: Add course materials
steps.description: Add the files Ori should read for this course.

steps.title: Keep course materials up to date
steps.description: Ori watches the chosen folder and checks saved links daily. Changes create a proposal for your review; Ori never changes course records automatically.

steps.title: Review course dates
steps.description: Review the bundled skill, then review every proposed item before anything is created.
